title: Regenerate Grafana dashboards after upgrade

detection.reason: Cluster inventory cannot reliably determine whether the dashboards are Istio's bundled Grafana dashboards or whether they are managed externally.

quote: - **Regenerate Grafana dashboards after upgrade** — If you use Istio's bundled Grafana dashboards, you'll need to regenerate them after upgrading to get the fixed dashboard linking. Dashboard UIDs are now explicitly defined to enable stable links between dashboards.
remediation: If you use Istio's bundled Grafana dashboards, regenerate them after upgrading.
verifyCommand: kubectl get configmaps -A -o custom-columns='NAMESPACE:.metadata.namespace,NAME:.metadata.name' | grep -i grafana # matching ConfigMaps are candidates for manual dashboard review

title: Replace removed Lightstep and Opencensus telemetry providers

detection.reason: Whether Lightstep or Opencensus is configured is encoded in nested telemetry provider references rather than a supported single inventory field.

quote: - **Deprecation of telemetry providers** — The telemetry providers Lightstep and Opencensus are removed in v1.27. Please use the OpenTelemetry provider instead.
remediation: Replace Lightstep and Opencensus telemetry provider configurations with the OpenTelemetry provider.
verifyCommand: kubectl get telemetry -A -o yaml | grep -iE 'lightstep|opencensus' # matching telemetry objects require replacement with OpenTelemetry

title: Test workloads and controllers for native sidecar compatibility

detection.reason: Eligibility for native sidecars and compatibility of mutating webhooks or controllers depend on admission behavior and workload/controller implementation that cluster inventory cannot settle.

quote: - **Native sidecar enabled by default** — Native sidecars are now enabled by default for eligible pods. This changes `istio-proxy`from a container to an init container. This can cause compatibility issues with other mutating webhooks or controllers in your cluster that expect to modify the `istio-proxy` as a regular container. Please test your workloads and controllers to ensure they are compatible with this change.
remediation: Test your workloads and controllers to ensure they are compatible with `istio-proxy` changing from a container to an init container.
verifyCommand: kubectl get pods -A -o yaml | grep -n -C 3 'istio-proxy' # matching pods are candidates for manual native-sidecar compatibility testing
